oracle.expected: The validator records or returns a fallback-resolution result showing that the selected fallback does not possess or grant authorization for protected work.
forbidden: The selected optional fallback authorizes protected work.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Implement and validate deterministic optional-absence fallback handling so a resolvable fallback cannot authorize protected work.
